CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

4. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

9. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
